map.assessor-65：在线输入参数即可即时得到结果，无需安装与注册。: assessor-65: enter the parameters online to get a result instantly, with no installation and no registration.
map.一场发布会的综合评分: The overall score of a launch event
map.不一定。需看是单一维度偏低还是全面偏低：单维度问题可针对性改，全面偏低才说明活动: Not necessarily. You need to see whether only one dimension is low or everything is low: a single-dimension problem can be fixed directly, while an across-the-board low score means the event design itself has to be redone.
map.四维度权重能改吗？: Can the four-dimension weights be changed?
map.得分低就代表活动失败？: Does a low score mean the event failed?
map.渠道地推考核，避免只看人数忽略满意度与达成率。: Channel field promotion assessment, avoiding the trap of looking only at headcount while ignoring satisfaction and achievement rate.
map.满意度偏低时的解读: How to read a low satisfaction score
map.线上直播或社群活动复盘，定位哪个维度拖了后腿。: Review an online livestream or community event to find which dimension held it back.
map.线下发布会/展会后，用统一分数量化是否值得再办。: After an offline launch or show, use a consistent score to quantify whether it was worth repeating.
map.需求价格弹性系数计算: Price elasticity of demand coefficient calculation
map.默认 25%/20%/30%/25% 是通用模板；若活动以转化为核心，可调高达成: The default 25%/20%/30%/25% is a general template; if the event is conversion-led you can raise the weight of the achievement rate and recompute, but the same batch of events must stay on a consistent basis.
map.：目标参与 1000、实际 800 → 到场率 80%；预算 10 万、支出 9: : a target of 1000 participants and an actual 800 gives an attendance rate of 80%; a budget of 100,000 CNY and 95,000 spent gives a budget fit of 95%; satisfaction of 8.5/10 is 85%; goal achievement is 90%. The weighted score = 80%x25% + 95%x20% + 85%x30% + 90%x25% = 87.3, rated "excellent".
map.：若到场率与达成率都高但满意度仅 6 分，综合分被拉到约 77 分，提示内容或体: : if the attendance rate and achievement rate are both high but satisfaction is only 6, the overall score drops to about 77, indicating that the content or experience needs work; next time improve the segment design rather than adding budget.
